attchmntText: National Fertilizers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: National Fertilizers Limited submitted un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The Board of Directors took these results on record during a meeting held on November 11, 2026, in Noida. The meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 04:42 P.M. The standalone results include subsidy income of Rs. 19891 Lakhs recognized on the sale of closing stock of DAP and TSP. Additionally, revenue as subsidy income of Rs. 11700 Lakhs was accounted for regarding the fixation of New Energy Norms applicable from April 1, 2025, to March 31, 2028. The consolidated results include the company's share of net profit after tax of Rs. 6297 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026, from joint ventures Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited, Urvarak Videsh Limited, and Assam Valley Fertilizers and Chemical Company Limited. Independent auditors Dassani and Associates LLP and N. K. Bhargava and Co. issued review reports with emphasis of matter regarding the subsidy income and restatement of financial statements for Assam Valley Fertilizers and Chemical Company Limited.
